about_the_game:
This digital soundtrack lets you enjoy both the new songs first released in PLATiNA :: LAB from the Early Access launch in April 2025 through August, as well as all the songs included in the "AQUA BLUE" DLC pack released in August 2025.

It includes a total of 46 tracks, featuring system BGM as well as Full and Instrumental versions of playable songs, provided in MP3 and WAV formats. A PDF booklet containing lyrics and additional information is also included.
